statement: If X_E^2 contains int_D (a0 R_AB^2 + a1 |nabla R_AB|^2) dmu plus nonnegative rest terms, with a0>0 and a1>0, then w_RAB=min(a0,a1) for the H1 norm int_D(R_AB^2+|nabla R_AB|^2).
If the R_AB value/gradient pair has a positive 2x2 coefficient matrix A_RAB in the selected norm basis, then w_RAB=lambda_min(A_RAB) after unit matching.

If R_AB mixes with other reciprocal variables y through quadratic block [[A,B],[B^T,C]], then R_AB is controlled only when A - B C^{-1} B^T >= w_RAB I with C positive; otherwise trace extraction may be noncoercive.
output: w_RAB=lambda_min(A - B C^{-1} B^T) when positive.
